sentences.text: The documents do not state a gold-loan-specific prepayment/foreclosure charge; the in-force bank policy says foreclosure charges of 2% plus GST on the principal outstanding shall be levied on all term loans pre-closed by the borrower, and the applicability of pre-payment charges shall be disclosed in the KFS and loan agreement.
The documents also contain a conflicting home-loan agreement copy that says 3% of the principal outstanding, while another in-force copy says 2% of the principal outstanding.

The UCB directions say that, for cases other than those in paragraph 261(1) and (2), pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB, and in case of term loans they shall be based on the amount being prepaid.

missing.searched: searched evidence for gold loan / gold-loan-specific charge and found only term-loan policy, home-loan agreement, and UCB directions
